subject: One of my Linkage Group Started from 50cM

messages.author: 398c6c5b14450efb
messages.subject: One of my Linkage Group Started from 50cM
parts:
I'm recently constructing my genetic map, step by step with the tutorial.
One thing I noticed is that my chr11 always started from 50cM instead of 0cM,
No matter how many times I reorder my markers.

It still looks good on PlotMap() though.
Does anyone know where's the problem and how to fix it? thx.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] One of my Linkage Group Started from 50cM
parts:
You can use the function shiftmap() to shift the starting position of all chromosomes to 0.

karl
